draft.subject: Request for Noon Report for ETA Calculation
draft.body:
Dear Master,

Please provide a noon report (including position, speed, fuel consumption, etc.) so we can compute and provide the latest ETA Gdynia to Hanse Steel Chartering in response to their email em-0411. We currently lack a processed noon report to determine the ETA.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
[Your Name/Operator]
